title: Does Poshmark Take Afterpay? What Works at Checkout
summary: Does Poshmark take Afterpay? No. See which payments actually work, how Klarna and Zip compare, and what it means for sellers before you buy.
body_markdown:
Does Poshmark take Afterpay? No. Poshmark's checkout doesn't accept Afterpay, Klarna, or Zip directly,


and the only payment methods that actually work there are credit and debit cards, Apple Pay, and Poshmark credit or gift cards. So where does the confusion come from? Afterpay, Zip, and Klarna each run their own Poshmark storefront pages, where you can buy a Poshmark gift card or use a browser extension to get something Afterpay-adjacent at checkout. That's a workaround, not a built-in checkout option.


If you're a buyer hoping to spread out a purchase, or a seller wondering whether buy now, pay later changes how you get paid, here's what actually happens at checkout.


## Main Takeaways


- **Poshmark's checkout options** are limited to credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, and Poshmark balance or gift cards. No Afterpay, Klarna, or Zip button exists.
- **Afterpay's Poshmark storefront** sells only a Poshmark gift card redeemable at checkout: the sole Afterpay-adjacent path available to buyers.
- **Zip's Chrome extension** applies its Pay in 4 plan directly at Poshmark's own checkout, making it closer to true buy now, pay later than the gift-card route.
- **Klarna's Poshmark storefront** mirrors Afterpay's model: a gift card purchase, not native support inside Poshmark's checkout flow.
- **Gift-card workarounds** mean you repay Afterpay or Klarna on their installment schedule, while Poshmark sees only a standard gift-card redemption.
- **Sellers' payouts** aren't affected by how a buyer funds a purchase. Poshmark's payout timing stays the same regardless of BNPL use.


## Buy Now, Pay Later Options for Poshmark: Comparison


BNPL Service Works Directly at Poshmark Checkout? Workaround How It Works Best For


Afterpay No Buy a Poshmark gift card via Afterpay Pay for the gift card in 4 installments, redeem code at checkout Buyers who know their cart total in advance


Klarna No Buy a Poshmark gift card via Klarna Same gift-card model as Afterpay One-off larger purchases


Zip Partial Zip browser extension / app Applies Pay in 4 at Poshmark's own checkout page Buyers wanting the closest thing to native BNPL


Affirm No None currently offered for Poshmark N/A Not applicable today


PayPal Pay in 4 No None — PayPal itself is a legacy option only, not always available N/A Not a reliable path


Does Poshmark take Afterpay through any of these providers directly? No, each one works around Poshmark's checkout instead of inside it. If you're weighing Poshmark buy now, pay later options side by side, here's what each service actually lets you do, from gift-card purchases to browser-extension checkouts:


- **Afterpay:** sells a Poshmark gift card on its own site, paid in four installments, with no direct checkout integration
- **Klarna:** same model as Afterpay, a Poshmark gift card purchased on Klarna's storefront and redeemed manually
- **Zip:** a browser extension that applies Pay in 4 at Poshmark's actual checkout on compatible orders, the closest thing to native BNPL
- **Affirm:** has no Poshmark storefront or browser extension at all, so it's absent from this resale marketplace entirely
- **PayPal Pay in 4:** has no Poshmark storefront, gift card, or checkout integration. Not recommended, since it offers no dependable BNPL access at Poshmark checkout


## Why Poshmark Doesn't Take Afterpay at Checkout


Poshmark runs a closed payment system built around its own escrow-style model. When you buy something, Poshmark holds the funds until you confirm delivery or the three-day inspection window closes, then releases payment to the seller.


That structure doesn't map onto how Afterpay, Klarna, or Zip operate


: each of those extends short-term credit and collects installments directly from the shopper, a separate financial relationship Poshmark's checkout was never built to route around.


Resale also carries higher return and dispute rates than new-goods retail. Sizing issues, authenticity questions, and condition disputes are common in secondhand fashion, and that raises underwriting risk for a BNPL provider, since a refund or reversed transaction after an installment plan has started complicates repayment.


That's likely why BNPL adoption lags behind straightforward retail checkouts here. PayPal's Pay in 4 plan, for comparison, already plugs into plenty of ordinary retail checkouts. It isn't a Poshmark payment option either, but it shows how much smoother BNPL integration can be outside resale.


Poshmark isn't an outlier here, either. Neither Mercari nor Depop natively integrates Afterpay, Klarna, or Zip at checkout


, and both lean on the same kind of third-party gift-card or extension workarounds where they exist at all.


## Poshmark's Actual Accepted Payment Methods


Poshmark keeps its checkout simple by design. According to[Poshmark's own payments page](https://about.poshmark.com/payments) , four payment methods work directly on the platform, and understanding each one clarifies where the Afterpay confusion actually creeps in:


- Credit and debit cards, including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover
- Apple Pay, available on iOS checkout
- Poshmark credit, earned from your own sales or refunds
- Poshmark gift cards, including ones purchased through Afterpay's or Klarna's storefront pages


### Credit and Debit Cards


Credit and debit cards are the default option at Poshmark checkout, and for most buyers, the most reliable one too. Poshmark accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover, processed the same way as any major online retailer. There's no special setup, no linked extension, and no third party approving your purchase. Every listing supports this payment method without exception.


### Apple Pay


Apple Pay works inside the Poshmark iOS app and is the fastest way to check out on a phone. You skip re-entering card details entirely: authenticate with Face ID or Touch ID, and the purchase completes in seconds. It's not available on desktop checkout, though, so Android and web shoppers default to a card instead.


### Poshmark Credit and Gift Cards


Poshmark credit accumulates from your own sales, canceled orders, or approved returns, and it sits in your account balance until you spend it or request a payout. Gift cards work the same way at checkout, and this is where the Afterpay and Klarna connection actually lives. Both[Afterpay](https://www.afterpay.com/en-US/gift-cards/POSHMARK_USD) and[Klarna](https://www.klarna.com/us/store/617fd06e-90b5-47fe-bb0e-65331ad7487b/Poshmark/pay-with-klarna/) sell Poshmark gift cards through their own storefronts, and once you have the code, you redeem it exactly like any other gift card. Poshmark's system doesn't distinguish a code bought through Afterpay from one bought off a grocery store rack. It's just a redemption.


## How to Use Afterpay to Shop on Poshmark Anyway


If you're determined to make a Poshmark Afterpay purchase work, the process runs through Afterpay's site, not Poshmark's checkout:


- Go to[Afterpay's Poshmark gift-card page](https://www.afterpay.com/en-US/gift-cards/POSHMARK_USD) and choose a denomination
- Check out on Afterpay, splitting the cost into four installments over six weeks
- Receive the gift card code by email and redeem it in your Poshmark account
- Apply the credited balance toward your purchase at Poshmark's normal checkout


The catch is denomination


. Afterpay's gift cards come in fixed amounts, so unless your cart total matches one exactly, you'll either round up and let the leftover sit as Poshmark credit for next time, or pair the gift card with another payment method to cover the gap.


[Zip's browser extension](https://zip.co/us/store/poshmark) gets closer to native BNPL


. It applies a Pay in 4 plan directly at Poshmark's checkout on compatible orders: install the extension, shop Poshmark normally, and select Zip when it appears as a checkout option. No gift card required.


One clarifying note: if Afterpay's site surfaces a listing for "Posh By V," that's an unrelated third-party boutique reseller, not Poshmark. Confirm you're on Afterpay's actual Poshmark gift-card page before you buy.


## What This Means for Poshmark Sellers


Sellers get paid the same way no matter how the buyer funded checkout. Once you ship and the buyer confirms receipt, or the three-day inspection window passes without a dispute, Poshmark releases funds to your balance, and[how to get paid on Poshmark](https://blog.vendoo.co/how-to-get-paid-on-poshmark) from there comes down to a bank transfer or Instant Pay.


Whether the buyer paid with a debit card, Apple Pay, or a gift card bought through Afterpay's installment plan, the sale posts to Poshmark the same way. BNPL is invisible from where you stand.


Buyer payment flexibility still matters for how much you sell, though. Some shoppers specifically browse platforms where BNPL is already built into checkout, and a buyer who'd rather split a $150 purchase into four payments may abandon a Poshmark cart entirely rather than pay upfront.


Relying on Poshmark alone for volume means missing that segment, which is one more reason to keep the[best alternatives to Poshmark](https://blog.vendoo.co/5-best-alternatives-to-poshmark-for-resellers) in your rotation for reaching BNPL-first shoppers.


Cross-listing the same inventory to marketplaces with different payment flexibility, like Mercari, Depop, or a Shopify storefront with native Affirm or Shop Pay support, puts your listings in front of buyers who'd rather finance a purchase than pay it off in full. It doesn't change how you get paid on Poshmark. It just adds more places a sale can close.

## Final Thoughts


Poshmark still doesn't take Afterpay at checkout, not natively, and not in any form Poshmark itself processes. What you get instead are workarounds: an Afterpay or Klarna gift card you buy on their site and redeem on Poshmark, or Zip's browser extension applying its Pay in 4 plan closer to Poshmark's actual checkout. None of it changes what Poshmark itself accepts. Cards, Apple Pay, and Poshmark credit or gift cards remain the only direct options.


For sellers, the bigger takeaway isn't Poshmark's payment policy, it's where your buyers are shopping. If BNPL access shapes whether a sale happens at all, platforms that already support it deserve a spot in your crosslisting rotation alongside Poshmark.


## Frequently asked questions


### Can I pay with Afterpay directly on Poshmark?


No. Poshmark's checkout only accepts credit and debit cards, Apple Pay, and Poshmark credit or gift cards. Afterpay isn't a checkout option, so you won't find a button or integration inside Poshmark itself that lets you split a purchase into installments.


### How do I use Afterpay to buy something on Poshmark?


Buy a Poshmark gift card on Afterpay's site, paying in four installments over six weeks. Afterpay emails you a gift card code, which you redeem in your Poshmark account and apply toward your purchase at checkout.


### Does Zip work better than Afterpay for Poshmark purchases?


For most buyers, yes. Zip's browser extension applies its Pay in 4 plan directly at Poshmark's own checkout on compatible orders, without requiring you to buy a gift card first or match a fixed denomination.


### Will using a BNPL gift card affect what the seller gets paid?


No. Poshmark processes a BNPL-purchased gift card as a standard gift-card redemption. Sellers get paid on the same schedule, after the buyer confirms receipt or the three-day inspection window closes, regardless of how the buyer funded checkout.


### Does any resale marketplace support Afterpay natively?


Not really. Mercari and Depop have the same gap as Poshmark: no native Afterpay, Klarna, or Zip button at checkout. Resale's higher return and dispute rates make BNPL underwriting riskier, so most secondhand marketplaces lean on the same gift-card or browser-extension workarounds instead of native integration.
